capabilities.contract: Stable rows keyed by chainId plus pool address/poolId; raw values remain available to accessible labels and sorting.
Filters are explicit, serializable, resettable, and applied to table, summaries, and flow consistently.
One primary metric sort uses metric-contracts.json tie-break rules; null always sorts last.
Same-token groups have stable canonical token keys, show +N when collapsed, and preserve member ordering.
Pool and actions columns are locked; visibility/order reset is deterministic; versioned preferences may sync across devices only in a later implementation task.
Comparison uses the same snapshot/window for Fees, Volume, TVL, aTVL, Fee/TVL, Txs, and fee tier; unresolved metrics render unavailable.
Candles are ordered by unique timestamp and never synthesized across missing bars.
V4 requires pool identity and tickSpacing; missing decimal or price inputs remain unavailable.
Normal, duplicate, out-of-order, and reorg inputs follow fixture-index.json; filters and address aggregates share one canonical event set.

operationalStates.entry: No usable snapshot has been committed and a request is active.
operationalStates.render: Preserve table geometry with skeleton rows and aria-busy=true; controls that change the request remain available.

operationalStates.entry: A successful non-stale snapshot contains zero rows after current filters.
operationalStates.render: Show an unframed empty state and clear-filter command when filters are active; do not show zero-valued fake rows.

operationalStates.entry: No usable data exists and the request failed fatally, or retries are exhausted.
operationalStates.render: Expose safe error code/message with retry; never leak request credentials or raw provider errors.

operationalStates.entry: Usable data exists but SSE silence exceeds the contracted threshold.
operationalStates.render: Keep the last good snapshot, mark it stale with its as-of time, and disable claims of live ordering.

operationalStates.entry: Usable data exists while replay/reconnect is active.
operationalStates.render: Keep stable rows and preferences, show reconnecting status, and accept no gapped diffs until replay or snapshot succeeds.

persistence.filters: URL query when shareable; session otherwise

accessibility.table: semantic headers expose sort state; virtualized rows retain programmatic row identity
accessibility.status: loading uses aria-busy, error uses role=alert, connection changes use a polite live region
accessibility.controls: icon-only controls require accessible names and visible keyboard focus
accessibility.charts: provide textual metric summaries and tabular fallback
